title: Suppress stale startup errors after expected cancellation
goal: Ensure expected cancellation during startup or view teardown cannot leave a stale error banner presented as a current Agent failure.
context: KernelSession.run already treats CancellationError, cancelled URLError, and ProviderRuntimeError.cancelled as non-fatal but retained the previous lastError value, which Settings and Agent surfaces render as attention required.
forbidden_changes: Do not mark cancelled operations as successful or alter persisted runtime state.
acceptance_criteria: Each recognized cancellation path clears the stale lastError value.
Non-cancellation errors continue to populate lastError.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass.
verification: M3 and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA CI
On-device cold launch with a cancelled model preparation does not show a stale Attention banner
recovery: Revert this single logical task if genuine errors become hidden or cancellation behavior regresses.
